note: Track steps-to-leaps, step 1: Do and Re over a drone, then the book's one Do Re tune learned in the named stages (with the tune, Tune muted, Chords muted for a cappella) at 40 bpm. Key and tempo are moves in place of the old Key selector, and the line on what stays the same opens with {{?key}}.

exercise.title: Do and Re: one step up and home
exercise.why: Do blends with the drone and Re does not, so the drone tells you when you have left home and when you are back.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Sing the low {{1}}, step up to {{2}}, then come back to {{1}}. Sing them on the note names.
Practice until the step up feels the same size every time.
_Don't reach for high notes: the two lowest notes on the staff are the whole drill._

Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. The tune rocks between Do and Re and ends on a long Do. Sing along on the note names.
Sing along with the tune a few times. Then press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.
Once you can sing it without the tune leading you, press Chords to mute the chords too, and sing the tune a cappella.
{{?key}}In another key the notes are new, and Re is still one step above Do.
